briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.3%) with no strong risk-on signal, and available cash ($189.29) sits below the $500 minimum needed to open a new position anyway. Existing 7 positions are held unchanged — no forced buys or sells on a low-conviction day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" means keeping cash on hand rather than forcing it into the market. With only $189.29 available — below the $500 threshold needed to open a new position — and no strong bullish signal today, the disciplined move is to wait for a genuine risk-on setup rather than chase a mediocre trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是保留現金、不勉強進場投資。今日可用現金僅189.29美元，低於開新倉所需的500美元門檻，加上市場也未出現強烈的看多訊號，因此紀律性的做法是耐心等待真正的risk-on機會，而非勉強進行平庸的交易。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move — it reflects a broad, mild pullback rather than a sharp risk-off event. Without a strong bullish or bearish signal, this kind of session is typically driven by profit-taking and light volume rather than new fundamental news.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大主要指數皆小幅回落，走勢平淡且缺乏明確方向，NASDAQ下跌0.6%，標普500下跌0.3%。市場並未出現單一主導因素，反映的是溫和的整體回調，而非劇烈的risk-off拋售。在缺乏強烈利多或利空訊號的情況下，這類交易日通常源於獲利了結與交投清淡，而非新的基本面消息。
